scope: Apparatus and measurement diagrams beside practical methods; shared artwork reused in the practical-skills chapter.

placements.heading: Practical: specific heat capacity
placements.purpose: An insulated metal block contains a heater and temperature probe. A meter records electrical energy supplied.

placements.heading: Practical: thermal insulation
placements.purpose: Identical lidded beakers have equal water masses, probes and equal thicknesses of different insulation.

placements.heading: Practical: density
placements.purpose: The water level rises from V₁ to V₂ when an irregular solid is fully submerged. Its volume is the difference.

placements.heading: Practical: force and extension
placements.purpose: Unloaded and loaded spring lengths are read against a ruler with an eye-level pointer. Extension is their difference.

placements.heading: Practical: force, mass and acceleration
placements.purpose: A trolley carrying masses is pulled by a string over a pulley to a hanging mass. Light gates measure its motion.

placements.heading: Practical: resistance
placements.purpose: Ammeter in series; voltmeter across the selected wire length between fixed and movable contacts. A ruler measures that length.

placements.heading: Practical: resistance
placements.purpose: Series and parallel resistor circuits, each with an ammeter measuring total current and a voltmeter across the whole combination.

placements.heading: Practical: current–voltage characteristics
placements.purpose: Low-voltage supply, variable resistor, ammeter and test component in series; voltmeter across the component.

placements.heading: Practical: waves in water and solids
placements.purpose: A ripple tank plan shows six crests spanning five wavelengths. A vibrating string shows adjacent nodes separated by half a wavelength.

placements.heading: Practical: reflection and refraction
placements.purpose: Incident and reflected rays meet at a mirror. A separate parallel-sided block bends light towards the normal on entry and away on exit.

placements.heading: Practical: infrared absorption and emission
placements.purpose: A detector compares emission from Leslie cube faces. Separately, an infrared lamp heats matched black and shiny samples.
